title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Full Stack Developer

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** Approximately 4 years of professional software development experience

Job Overview

We are looking for a skilled and versatile **Full Stack Developer** with approximately 4 years of professional software development experience.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on expertise in **one backend technology**—Java, Python, or Node.js—and **one frontend technology**—React.js, Angular, or Vue.js. You should be comfortable working across the application stack and contributing to the **design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance** of scalable, secure, and production\-ready applications.

You will work closely with developers, QA engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to build reliable software and continuously improve application quality and performance.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable full\-stack applications.
* Develop secure, reliable, and scalable **RESTful APIs** and backend services.
* Build responsive, reusable, and maintainable frontend components.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend services and APIs.
* Design data models and develop efficient, optimized SQL queries.
* Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
* Monitor application performance and identify opportunities for optimization and improvement.
* Write unit and integration tests and participate in code reviews.
* Follow coding standards, software development best practices, and version\-control practices.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, QA engineers, and other developers.
* Participate in **Agile/Scrum ceremonies**, sprint planning, stand\-ups, retrospectives, and related activities.
* Contribute to technical discussions, application architecture, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

* Approximately **4 years of professional software development experience**.
* Strong programming fundamentals, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **at least one backend technology**:
* **Java:** Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security.
* **Python:** FastAPI, Django, or Flask, with REST API development.
* **Node.js:** Express.js or NestJS, REST APIs, and asynchronous programming.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **at least one frontend framework**:
* React.js
* Angular
* Vue.js
* Good knowledge of:
* JavaScript and/or TypeScript
* HTML5 and CSS3
* Responsive web development
* Component\-based architecture
* REST API integration
* Frontend debugging and performance optimization
* Experience with at least one relational database:
* PostgreSQL
* MySQL
* Oracle
* Strong understanding of **SQL, database design, and data modeling**.
* Understanding of REST APIs, authentication, authorization, and distributed application concepts.
* Experience using **Git** and modern software development practices.
* Good communication, debugging, teamwork, and collaboration skills.

Nice\-to\-Have Skills

* Experience with **microservices architecture** and system design.
* Cloud development experience with **AWS, Azure, or GCP**.
* Experience with **Docker and Kubernetes**.
* Familiarity with **CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices**.
* Experience with messaging and caching technologies such as **Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Redis**.
* Experience working in **Agile/Scrum environments**.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases such as **MongoDB**.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is not only technically strong but also takes ownership of their work, enjoys solving challenging problems, and can work effectively with cross\-functional teams.

The successful candidate should be comfortable learning new technologies, debugging complex issues, writing clean and maintainable code, and contributing throughout the software development lifecycle.

**If you are a Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in a backend and frontend technology and are looking for an opportunity to work on scalable, production\-grade applications, we would love to hear from you.**

Pay: From ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Quality Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Enables full stack solutions through multi\-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Performs continuous testing for security, API, and regression suite. Creates automation strategy, automated scripts and supports data and environment configuration. Participates in code reviews, monitors, and reports defects to support continuous improvement activities for the end\-to\-end testing process.
  

**Must have skills :** Test Management  

**Good to have skills :** Automated Testing, Quality Management  

Minimum **2** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

Software Quality Engineers design, create, implement, and monitor
  

processes that ensure that the final product satisfies end users
  

needs and requirements, while also making sure no other influence
  

will cause the product to malfunction.
  

Being able to fully understand what project managers and product
  

owners expect, and to imagine what end users need and how they
  

will interact with the product are just some of the points that a Soft  

ware Quality Engineer has to be able to fulfill.
  

Clear and precise communications enable a Quality Assurance En  

gineer to address identified problems quickly to relevant partners in
  

other teams and make a valuable contribution to improving the
  

overall product quality.
  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback.
  

* Create detailed, comprehensive and well\-structured test plans and test cases to identify software problems.
* Estimate, prioritize, plan and coordinate testing activities.
* Identify, record, document thoroughly and track bugs.
* Perform thorough regression testing when bugs are resolved.
* Develop and apply testing processes for new and existing products.
* Liaise with internal teams (e.g. product leads and developers) to identify system requirements.
* Investigate the causes of non\-conforming software.
* Work together with software developers to enhance and improve software.
* Track quality assurance metrics, like defect densities and open defect counts.
* Stay up\-to\-date with new testing tools and test strategies.

  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related
  

subject or comparable qualifications/experience.
  

* Proven work experience in software development or in soft


ware quality assurance.
  

* Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and

processes.
  

* Experience in writing clear, concise and comprehensive test

plans, test cases and defect descriptions.
  

* ISTQB or related certification is preferable.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 2 years of experience in Test Management.
* This position is based at our Chennai office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

Join us as a Full Stack Developer, at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.


To be successful as a Full Sta, you should have experience with:


* Java, Spring Boot, and REST API development
* Angular (or modern JavaScript frameworks) including component\-based architecture and reactive forms
* Database technologies such as SQL, Oracle/PostgreSQL, JPA/Hibernate, and data modelling
* Software engineering best practices including CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, and Git.

Some other highly valued skills may include:


* Kafka or event\-driven architecture
* Cloud platforms such as AWS and containerization technologies (Docker/Kubernetes)
* Microservices and distributed systems design
* Agile delivery methodologies, DevOps practices, and production support experience

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


The role is based out of Chennai and Pune.


**Purpose of the role**


To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.


**Accountabilities**


* Development and delivery of high\-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.

* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.

* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.

* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.

* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Lead Full Stack Developer
description:
**Lead Developer, Full\-Stack (Node.js / React/ PostgreSQL)**

**Company:** Justo Global (justoglobal.com) / The Ark Enterprise (thearkenterprise.com)

**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. On\-site (some flexibility for the right candidate) Type:

**Full\-time Experience:** 7 to 10 years overall, including 2\+ years leading or mentoring a team

**Notice:** Immediate joiners preferred; candidates on up to 30 days' notice welcome

**About the Role**

Justo Global builds cloud, web, mobile, data, and AI solutions for global clients, mostly

across North America. We're hiring a Lead Developer to own the technical delivery of these

projects: a hands\-on leader who spends most of the week writing and reviewing code, and

the rest setting direction, mentoring the team, and keeping delivery on track.

In 2026, we expect our leads to work fluently alongside AI coding tools, using them to move

faster while keeping firm ownership of architecture, code quality, and security. If you love

building and leading, keep reading.

**What You'll Do**

* Own architecture, design, and delivery of scalable, secure, highly available applications for global clients.
* Write and review production code daily across frontend, backend, and APIs. You set the quality bar through your own work.
* Lead a small team: mentoring, code reviews, sprint planning, estimation, and unblocking.
* Translate client and business requirements into clear technical plans and break them down for the team.
* Establish engineering best practices: coding standards, testing discipline, CI/CD hygiene, and secure\-by\-design defaults.
* Make and document architectural trade\-offs across performance, cost, and maintainability.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools effectively, and set sensible team guardrails for reviewing and securing AI\-generated code.
* Work directly with US\-based clients, product, and design; represent engineering in stakeholder conversations.

**Must\-Have Skills**

**Leadership \& Architecture**

* Proven experience designing, building, and scaling robust, secure, highly available enterprise\-grade software.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor developers while staying deeply hands\-on.
* Strong ownership of delivery: planning, estimating, and shipping reliably.

**Core Stack**

* Deep expertise in the modern JavaScript / TypeScript ecosystem: runtimes, build tools, and package managers.
* Strong Node.js: scalable backend services and REST / GraphQL APIs with Express or Fastify.
* Extensive React.js: complex, responsive UIs with hooks, Context API, and modern state management (Redux, Zustand).
* Advanced PostgreSQL: schema design, query optimization, indexing, and data modeling.

**Cloud \& Infrastructure**

* Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP): deploying, scaling, and running production workloads.
* Solid working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and running containerized services (cluster operations experience is a plus, not a requirement).
* Understanding of cloud cost, reliability, and observability basics (logging, metrics, tracing).

**Delivery \& Tooling**

* Modern workflows: Git, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar).
* Testing discipline with Jest, Mocha, or PyTest.
* Sound application\-security fundamentals: authentication/authorization, secrets handling, and secure defaults.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Python (Django / FastAPI) for backend, data processing, or scripting.
* React Native for cross\-platform mobile.
* Go / Golang for high\-concurrency microservices.
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, Helm) and managed Kubernetes (EKS / GKE /AKS).
* Experience integrating LLM / AI features (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, or similarAPIs)into production products.

**Soft Skills, What Sets Our Leads Apart**

These matter as much as the technical checklist. For a client\-facing lead, most friction is

human, not technical.

* **Communication (the big one):** clear written and spoken English; explains technical trade\-offs to non\-technical, US\-based clients and turns vague business asks into concrete plans.
* **Client\-facing maturity:** confident in stakeholder calls, manages expectations, and gives honest status, including bad news, without drama.
* **Ownership across time zones:** takes end\-to\-end responsibility and communicate proactively so US clients aren't left waiting on Coimbatore hours.
* **Leadership \& mentorship:** grows people through review and pairing; gives feedback that's direct but kind; builds trust rather than commanding.
* **Pragmatism \& decisiveness:** makes sound calls with incomplete information and balances "perfect" against "shipped."
* **Constructive collaboration:** disagrees well, commits once decided, and keeps client relationships steady under pressure.
* **Adaptability:** stays effective as priorities and client domains shift

Pay: ₹150,000\.00 \- ₹250,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Full-Stack Technical Lead
description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking an M\-shaped Full\-Stack Technical Lead with expert\-level Java engineering skills and accountability for delivery across the platform. This role is not a traditional full\-stack position—the successful candidate will have deep, end\-to\-end expertise in Java as their primary discipline, while independently managing small\- to medium\-complexity tasks in three secondary areas: React front\-end development, DevSecOps, and Test Automation. AI and Agentic AI tools will be leveraged to enhance capabilities across these secondary domains without requiring deep specialization in each. The role includes platform\-wide technical leadership responsibilities, such as setting standards, reviewing designs, coaching engineers, and embedding quality early through shift\-left practices.


##### **Responsibilities**


Design, develop, and maintain Spring Boot microservices integrating with relational and NoSQL databases, message brokers (Kafka), and internal/external APIs, ensuring scalable and reliable services across on\-premise and cloud environments.


Manage REST API design end\-to\-end, including contract definition, versioning, error handling, performance optimization, and reliability, to meet non\-functional requirements and consumer expectations.


Serve as the technical leader for Java engineering platform\-wide, establishing coding standards, architectural patterns, reviewing designs and pull requests, and providing technical guidance to delivery teams.


Lead performance tuning and optimization of Java services by profiling, identifying bottlenecks related to memory, threading, I/O, and database, and implementing solutions collaboratively with engineering teams.


Implement Test\-Driven Development (TDD) as a foundational practice in Java delivery, ensuring testability is embedded from the outset.


Develop and maintain React components, screens, and features for small


to medium\-complexity front\-end tasks, integrating with back\-end APIs via RESTful services.


Utilize hooks, state management, and component lifecycle methods to deliver functional and responsive user interfaces aligned with design requirements.


Employ AI and Agentic AI tools to expedite front\-end development, including scaffolding components and troubleshooting UI issues, without requiring extensive front\-end specialization.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The role demands advanced proficiency in modern Java programming, emphasizing core concepts such as concurrency, streams, and modular design, with Java 17\+ being preferable. Candidates must exhibit substantial experience in architecting and developing Spring Boot microservices within large\-scale enterprise settings. Expertise in database interactions is essential, including strong skills in SQL, JPA/Hibernate, query optimization, and data modeling. Familiarity with event\-driven system design and message brokers, particularly Apache Kafka, is required. Deploying and managing Java services via containerization (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) is a key responsibility. Additionally, candidates should demonstrate the ability to design robust REST APIs, incorporating principles like contract\-first design, versioning, pagination, error management, and optimization of API performance. Experience in performance tuning involving profiling, heap and thread analysis, garbage collection adjustments, and latency minimization is also necessary. A rigorous approach to test\-driven development and unit/integration testing, using frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito, is expected. Candidates must also have experience delivering solutions in both on\-premise and cloud environments.


Soft skills and front\-end competencies include the ability to construct React components utilizing functional programming patterns, hooks, and state management techniques. A solid command of JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3 is required to effectively integrate front\-end modules with back\-end RESTful services. Proficiency in managing asynchronous data flows between client and server components is essential to ensure seamless user experiences.


Hard skills:


At least 10 years of experience in IT.


Expertise in Java 17\+ with modern features including concurrency, streams, and modular design


Extensive experience building Spring Boot microservices


Proficient in SQL, JPA/Hibernate, query optimization, and data modeling


Skilled in event\-driven architectures with Apache Kafka


Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for Java service deployment


REST API design focusing on contract\-first, versioning, pagination, error handling, and performance


Performance tuning including profiling, heap/thread analysis, garbage collection tuning, latency reduction


Strong TDD and unit/integration testing using JUnit, Mockito, or equivalents


Experience with on\-premise and cloud deployments


Soft skills:


Competent in creating React components using functional components, hooks, and state management


Solid knowledge of JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3


Ability to integrate front\-end with back\-end REST APIs and manage asynchronous data flows
